title: codeaster-en message catalogue (en/messages/<FAMILY>.en.json)
description: One code_aster message family (one file upstream code_aster/Messages/<family>.py), written by `caen extract messages` (task 1.3). The extractor owns every field except the translation fields (en, method, severity_hint, translation_source, reviewed_by, reviewed_on, note, stale), which the translate tool and reviewers fill in and which re-extraction carries over. Change the extractor (tools/codeaster_en/extract/messages.py), not the extracted fields.

family.description: Upstream file name in upper case (mecanonline10.py -> MECANONLINE10). Message IDs are <FAMILY>_<N>.

messages.description: Keyed by the message number as a string, in numeric order.

fr.description: French text verbatim (leading/trailing newlines kept): the %-format string Utmess formats with a mapping.

placeholders.description: Distinct printf specifiers in fr, as written, in order of first appearance; '%%' (literal percent) included.

line.description: Line of the message number in the upstream file.

flags.description: Dict-form messages only: the 'flags' string verbatim (DECORATED, CENTER). Utmess eval()s it.

gettext.description: Present (false) when the text is not a plain string inside _(): either not wrapped at all, or an f-string. gettext cannot translate such messages at runtime.

fstring_names.description: f-string messages: module-level string constants substituted into fr.

reachable.description: Present (false) for N >= 100: Utmess.decode_idmess asserts 0 < N < 100, so the solver cannot emit the message.

en.description: English text with the same placeholder set as fr; null until translated.

translation_source.description: Where en came from when it was not written here, e.g. upstream:i18n/en-US/aster_messages.po.

note.description: Translator's note for the reviewer; never shown to users.

stale.description: true when fr changed upstream after en was written.
